item.title: Version 0.1.19
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.19 — fix the "A more realistic target?" banner ignoring your weekly history.
The popover banner was confidently telling 85 km/week runners that their 4-week average was 15.3 km. Cause: the suggestion engine read 4 ISO weeks of raw activity rows, but Stravas API Agreement § 7.1 only lets us cache 7 days of activities. The other three weeks of the 4-week lookback were 0 km zeros, dragging the average down to roughly 1/4 of reality and triggering a spurious decrease suggestion.
The engine now reads weekly km from the persisted WeeklySnapshot history (which we already fill via 8-week seed on Strava connect, see 0.1.18). Conformant — and the suggestion finally reflects your actual recent pace.
